reason: The array is covered in grit, so brushing it seems like a practical first step toward restoring solar power and restarting services.
expectation: I expect to clear the panels and improve their output, though the services may need further steps to restart.

alternatives.reason: Refilling the water line could restore water service, but the earlier thaw checks suggest it should be ready before water enters.
Moving lettuce back to the window seems useful now that sunlight has returned, but I want to address the power supply first.

effect: The cleaned array now provides a restored solar supply, making the plant restart controls available.
reaction: It was satisfying to restore power with a straightforward cleaning step.
reason: The restored supply can now be connected to the plant restart controls, which seems directly relevant to restarting essential services.
expectation: I expect the plant to begin restarting on solar power, though other services may still need attention.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also seems useful, but I would first use the newly restored power supply.

effect: The return plant has restarted and can replace propellant lost during the shutdown over the coming weeks. The water line still needs attention.
reaction: The propellant loss was an interesting consequence of the shutdown.
reason: Restoring the drained water line seems like the next direct step toward restarting essential services.
expectation: I expect the line to be refilled and water service restored, though it may need additional checks.

alternatives.reason: Moving the lettuce back toward sunlight also seems useful, but I want to restore the water line first.

effect: The exterior line is primed and water reaches the tap again. Essential services are restarted, and the remaining goal is to return both troughs to the window.
reaction: It is reassuring to see the water service restored.
reason: Both troughs need to return to the window; I will move the lettuce first.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed on the window shelf, with the potato trough still to move.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to go to the shelf, but I have no clear reason to move it first.

effect: The lettuce trough is at the window shelf; the potato trough still needs to be moved.
reaction: Nothing notable; the placement worked as expected.
reason: Moving the potato trough is the only remaining gameplay action and advances the goal of returning both beds to the window.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to be placed on the window shelf, completing the current goal.

effect: The potato trough reached the window shelf, completing the goal and the chapter.
reaction: The placement worked as expected; nothing notable surprised me.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the return plant was most worthwhile because the result showed that the shutdown had cost some stored propellant and that replacing it would take weeks.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was straightforward but repetitive; there was no clear reason to prefer one order over the other.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some stored propellant boiled away during the shutdown, making recovery take weeks.

arbitrary.text: The order of the two trough placements felt arbitrary, although the purpose of moving both back to the window was clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the propellant recovery leaves me curious about how the return journey will unfold.
